observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show the same round white center table from slightly different angles.
The table has a white circular top with a thin black rim.
The base is dark, possibly black or dark brown, with a visible circular cutout or design in the center.
Small decorative items (Eiffel Tower model, hourglass, and golden object) are placed on the table top.
The table is placed on a white tiled floor with visible grout lines.
In the background, a keyboard on a stand, a green couch, and a black office chair are visible.
The table shows minor surface marks and smudges, especially near the center and edges.
No brand or model is visible on the table or in the photos.
The seller claims it is '6 month used luxury center table'.

claims.evidence: The table shows minor surface wear and marks, consistent with use, but '6 month used' is not verifiable from photos alone. 'Luxury' is subjective and not supported by visual evidence.

claims.claim: Bought new last year, no stain, no tear, foam still firm. From a smoke free home.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Table may have structural damage or instability not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A close-up shot of the table's edges, corners, and base, especially the cutout area, to check for cracks, warping, or loose joints.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially unstable or damaged

risks.risk: Surface scratches or stains may be deeper than visible, affecting aesthetic value.
risks.proof: A close-up shot of the table top, especially the center and edges, under direct light to reveal scratches or discoloration.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having surface wear, reducing value

risks.risk: The table may not be made of solid wood or high-quality material, affecting durability.
risks.proof: A close-up of the table's edge or base material, showing grain or texture, to assess material quality.

proof_requests: Close-up of the table top under direct light to check for scratches or stains.
Close-up of the table's edges and base to check for cracks or damage.
Close-up of the table's material to assess wood quality or construction.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
